title: Beets AI resource index
description: Machine-readable index of every free teaching resource published at beets-ai.com. Served at https://beets-ai.com/resources.json and regenerated on every publish. Newest first. Each item pairs the Traditional Chinese edition (site root) with the English edition (/en/), and gives the hero image used as the page's social card.

site.description: Origin the resource URLs are built against.

generated.description: Build time in Hong Kong time, with an explicit +08:00 offset.

count.description: Length of `resources`. Lets a consumer confirm it read the whole file.

resources.description: Every published resource, newest publication first; ties broken by `id`.

id.description: Stable address, identical in both editions. Last segment of the URL in each language.

published.description: First publication date in Hong Kong time (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated.description: Most recent publication date in Hong Kong time (YYYY-MM-DD). Equal to `published` when the resource has never changed.

version.description: 1.0 at first publication, +0.1 per later publication.

theme.description: Library theme: A school planning, B responsible AI use, C seeing student thinking, D Hong Kong inquiry, E first & inclusive lessons.

stage.description: Learning stage as published, e.g. P4-P6 or S1-S3.

title.description: The page title in that edition's language.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page, with a trailing slash.

image.description: Absolute URL of the hero image (the page's social card). Omitted only if a page has no hero.
